Duplicate three-run factors when b=d are removed by −Iz. The resulting exact count agrees with independently enumerated closed substrings on 1,024 positive five-tuples (each run 1..4). For quadratic Q=t(x+y)+Ixy, unequal b,d give Q≤n²/12; equal b,d give the explicit nonnegative n²/8−Q identity. Its vanishing asymptotics establish limiting shape rigidity, with finite checks not serving as universal proof.
